prompt:
Scene:
A top-down square photograph of the photo-feature spread of the same zine from the reference. The grey newsprint paper tone, drum-line streaks, and photocopy grain are identical. A marker pen rolls off the lower-left edge just in frame.

Subject:
The photo-feature spread showcases four photocopied black-and-white photographs at jumbled sizes — two pasted slightly over the center seam, one rotated 8 degrees, one half-cut with scissor-frays. Around them, handwritten ballpoint blue captions cluster at angles, a highlighter-yellow box frames a detail, and a strip of black electrical tape runs down the inside gutter with air bubbles along the edge.

Important details:
Preserve exact identity established by the reference: same grey newsprint, same photocopy grain, same highlighter yellow, ballpoint blue, tomato red marker, same scissor-fray edges, same glue halo style. The black electrical tape must have rubbery texture and realistic air bubbles, not painted-on look. Photographs must be photocopied — high contrast, pure-black shadows, crushed mid-tones.

Use case:
Series image 3 of 4 · the photo spread of the same zine, continuing the paper and hand.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no color photos (must be photocopy-grade B&W), no symmetry, no flat digital tape, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio.
title: Zine Photo Spread
description: The interior photo-feature spread of the same zine, four photocopied portraits with handwritten captions and electrical tape gutter.

generation.runner_notes: Depends on cover for paper and palette continuity.
